name: Image to Image
description: Z-Image-Turbo. Upload a picture and describe how it should look. Keeps the layout, changes style and details (denoise 0.8, about 1 megapixel).
promptGuide: Describe the whole picture you want to end up with, not only the change: subject, setting, lighting and style, about 30 to 80 words. The start image gives the layout and colors; the prompt changes content and style.
